name: project_brief_set
title: Confirm the Project working brief
description: Confirms the Project's working brief: the durable steering text every host and ingest synthesis reads for this Project (what to make, tone, audience, what to avoid). It is standing direction for Project work; the person's explicit current request takes precedence over it. It records standing direction for the Project as a whole as the person states or corrects it, and each confirmation replaces the whole brief. Requires the current brief revision as expected_revision (0 when no brief exists yet); episode_read on an Episode in the Project renders the exact current PROJECT WORKING BRIEF block with its revision; a stale revision fails without overwriting a newer confirmation. Retrying the exact same confirmation with the same idempotency_key replays as a no-op, even after a later confirmation; the same key with different text fails closed. An empty brief clears steering. Confirming never touches sibling direction settings such as canonical vocabulary or copy preferences, and causes no Program edit, Clip, Render, publication, or public-link effect. Episode metadata is episode_update, and channel/package copy is publish_prepare / publish_update.

project_id.description: Project public ID (show_...) or UUID from projects_list / episode_read.

brief.description: The complete working brief text to confirm — it replaces the current brief. An empty string clears steering. Limited to 2000 characters.

expected_revision.description: The current working-brief revision from a fresh episode_read (its PROJECT WORKING BRIEF block states the revision). 0 for a Project with no confirmed brief yet.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-stable key for an exact safe retry of this one confirmation.

examples.label: Set standing direction for a Project

input.brief: Audience: prospective customers. Tone: direct, no hype. Prefer moments showing the product working.

brief.description: The exact current confirmed brief after this call.

already_applied.description: true when this exact confirmation had already been applied and nothing changed.

applied_revision.description: The revision this confirmation originally produced; equals revision unless a later confirmation superseded it.
